title: AnnoBERT: Effectively Representing Multiple Annotators’ Label Choices to Improve Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Modeling annotator preferences and subjective viewpoints by generating annotator embeddings from their historical label choices using Collaborative Topic Regression (CTR), and evaluating performance on subsets of data with high inter-rater disagreement.

Evaluating model sensitivity and specificity on naturally and artificially imbalanced hate speech datasets to measure and mitigate the tendency of models to disproportionately favor the majority (non-hate) class.
